main_text.head: [illegible, ~14 letters]
main_text.p: De Sacrificijs, commemorationibus, & requiebus, quæ faciunt fideles pro Defunctis suis secundum Canones Apostolicos, dubitant indocti. Si enim nō profunt Sacrificia, & commemorationes Defunctis, quomodo credimus, quod Dominus Iesus Christus (cuius Maiestati adoratio) semetipsum obtulerit Sacrificium Patri, & soluerit debitum patris nostri Adami, ac peccatum eius remiserit, quod fuit causa mortis? Qui enim de hoc dubitat, Christianus non est.

page.notes: The Arabic-script lines (heading and body block) are illegible at this scan resolution, so only approximate letter counts are given. The number of Arabic lines in the block (about ten) is uncertain. The word "Cophtitis" is set with an Arabic word beside it. The catchword "Ab-" is taken as a hyphenated fragment at the foot. The Latin paragraph is transcribed from the scan; "requiebus" is printed as shown, and there are no Greek or Hebrew passages on this page.
